status.heading: Status
status.communityHelp: No licence is installed. Every licensed feature (IPsec, WireGuard, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, HA) is locked: a commit that adds new configuration for any of them is refused until a licence is installed. The running configuration stays applied.
status.expiredHelp: The licence is not usable (expired past its grace period, or invalid). The running configuration stays applied; new configuration for a licensed feature is refused at commit until a valid licence is installed.

upload.heading: Install a licence
upload.help: Choose the .vrxlic file you received from support. It is verified before it is stored.
upload.notJson: This file is not a VRX licence file.

banner.grace: The licence has expired. Grace period: {{days}} day(s) left.
banner.expired: The licence has expired. New configuration for licensed features is refused at commit until a valid licence is installed.
banner.invalid: The installed licence is not valid for this system. New configuration for licensed features is refused at commit.
banner.community: No licence is installed: new configuration for licensed features (IPsec, WireGuard, BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, HA) is refused until a licence is installed.
